title: Poe Dameron
description: Cocky and headstrong, Poe Dameron considered himself the best pilot in the Resistance, and it was a good thing he had the skills to match because his attitude often cost the Resistance. After learning his lesson on Crait, Poe dedicated himself to rebuilding the Resistance to fight the First Order's grip on the galaxy. But somehow Palpatine returned, and there was so much more work to do...
